grader: the live affine_math grader (probe_worker.grade) for both envs

holdout_exclusion.rule: a pool task is dropped if its problem matches a task of the private perf-eval holdout: sha256 of the raw problem text, sha256 of the normalised text (NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapsed), or token-3-gram Jaccard >= 0.9. The holdout itself stays private (size + sha256 in https://affine.io/performance.json).

line_format: one JSON object per line, sorted keys: id, env, problem, answer (+ src_index, uid for dapo); file order = math then dapo by id
prompt: [system: MANDATE, user: problem] for both envs (same as affine_math)
